name: claude-interleaved-output
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): interleaved output. The bytes of one event are split, and a second complete event is written into the gap — modelling two concurrent writers whose output interleaves on a single stream (no clean one-object-per-line framing). The consumer must not mis-parse the jammed-together bytes as one event. emit_raw writes fragments verbatim; run without --validate.
